item.title: Over growing trees in Westfield and Beverley surrounding roads, 29th July
item.description:
The trees in and round Westfield and Beverley surrounding roads require to be trimmed or cut back as they now grown over the pavement and road causing people to walk around them, as for car drivers they are causing visible restrictions at some of the junctions in the surrounding areas. It would be appreciated if the correct department can address this matter
